tha-ap185:1.1: samattaṃ. [183. Koṭumbariya.] Kaṇikāraṃ va jotantaṃ nisinnaṃ pabbatantare / appameyyaṃ va udadhim uddhataṃ dharaṇiṃ yathā. // //
tha-ap185:2.1: Paretaṃ devasaṅghena nisabhājāniyaṃ yathā / haṭṭho haṭṭhena cittena upagacchiṃ naruttamaṃ. // //
tha-ap185:3.1: Satta pupphāni paggayha koṭumbarasamākulaṃ / Buddhassa abhiropesiṃ Sikhino lokabandhuno. // //
tha-ap185:4.1: Ekatiṃse ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap185:5.1: Ito vīsatikappamhi Mahānela-sanāmako / eko āsiṃ mahātejo cakkavattī mahabbalo. // //
tha-ap185:7.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Koṭumbariyo thero i. g. a-ti.
